newsitem.title: USA: International Rect sees inventory solution.
newsitem.headline: International Rect sees inventory solution.

text.p: International Rectifier Corp's chief executive officer said current sales data indicates that distributors' excess inventories of a major product are falling and the inventory problem should be resolved by the end of its second quarter or December.

Derek Lidow, CEO, told the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference that the problem, which two weeks ago the company announced would hurt first quarter revenues and earnings, appears on the mend because sales have not dropped.
